The '''Toe-Chop's Tapcaf''' was a cafe in the [[Coratanni Town]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], the base of operations of the [[Ravagers]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Toe-Chop's Tapcaf appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
